entries.title: Mark 15:1
segments: And immediately in the morning the chief priests held a consultation with the elders and scribes and the whole council. And they bound Jesus and led [Him] away and delivered [Him] to Pilate.

entries.title: Mark 15:2
segments: And Pilate asked Him, Are you the king of the Jews? And answering He said to him, You say [it].

entries.title: Mark 15:3
segments: And the chief priests accused Him [of] many things, but He answered nothing.

entries.title: Mark 15:4
segments: And Pilate asked Him again, saying, Do you answer nothing? Behold how many things they witness against you?

entries.title: Mark 15:5
segments: But Jesus still answered nothing, so that Pilate marveled.

entries.title: Mark 15:6
segments: And at [that] feast he released to them one prisoner, whomever they desired.

entries.title: Mark 15:7
segments: And there was [one] named Barabbas, bound with the insurgents, who had committed murder in the insurrection.

entries.title: Mark 15:8
segments: And the crowd, crying aloud, began to beg [him to do] as he had always done to them.

entries.title: Mark 15:9
segments: But Pilate answered them, saying, Do you desire that I release to you the King of the Jews?

entries.title: Mark 15:10
segments: For he knew that the chief priests had delivered Him because of envy.

entries.title: Mark 15:11
segments: But the chief priests moved the people that he should rather release Barabbas to them.

entries.title: Mark 15:12
segments: And Pilate answered and said again to them, What then do you desire that I should do [to him] whom you call the King of the Jews?

entries.title: Mark 15:13
segments: And they cried out again, Crucify him!

entries.title: Mark 15:14
segments: Then Pilate said to them, Why? What evil has he done? And they much more cried out, Crucify him!

entries.title: Mark 15:15
segments: And deciding to do the easiest [to] the crowd, Pilate released Barabbas to them, and having scourged [Him], delivered up Jesus to be crucified.

entries.title: Mark 15:16
segments: And the soldiers led Him away inside the court, which is [the] praetorium. And they called together all the cohort.

entries.title: Mark 15:17
segments: And they clothed Him with purple and plaited a crown of thorns and put it around His [head].

entries.title: Mark 15:18
segments: And they began to salute Him, Hail, King of the Jews!

entries.title: Mark 15:19
segments: And they struck Him on the head with a reed, and spat on Him, and placing the knees, [they] bowed to Him.

entries.title: Mark 15:20
segments: And when they had mocked Him, they took the purple off Him and put His own clothes on Him and led Him out to crucify Him.

entries.title: Mark 15:21
segments: And they made one who was passing by, Simon a Cyrenian, coming out of the country, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to bear His cross.

entries.title: Mark 15:22
segments: And they brought Him to Golgotha Place (which translated is, Place of a Skull).

entries.title: Mark 15:23
segments: And they gave Him wine mixed with myrrh to drink. But He did not take [it].

entries.title: Mark 15:24
segments: And when they had crucified Him, they divided His garments, casting lots on them, as, to what [each] should take.

entries.title: Mark 15:25
segments: And it was [the] third hour, and they crucified Him.

entries.title: Mark 15:26
segments: And the inscription of His accusation was written over [Him], THE KING OF THE JEWS.

entries.title: Mark 15:27
segments: And with Him they crucified two thieves, the one off [the] right, and one off [the] left.

entries.title: Mark 15:28
segments: And the Scripture was fulfilled which said, "And he was numbered with [the] lawless."

entries.title: Mark 15:29
segments: And those who passed by blasphemed Him, wagging their heads and saying, Aha! You [razing] the temple and building [it] in three days,

entries.title: Mark 15:30
segments: save yourself and come down from the cross!

entries.title: Mark 15:31
segments: And also the chief priests mocking, with the scribes, said to one another, He saved others but he cannot save himself.

entries.title: Mark 15:32
segments: Let Christ the King of Israel now come down from the cross, so that we may see and believe. And they who were crucified with Him insulted Him.

entries.title: Mark 15:33
segments: And [it] being [the] sixth hour, darkness came over all the land until the ninth hour.

entries.title: Mark 15:34
segments: And at the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani? (which being translated is, My God, My God, why did You forsake Me?)

entries.title: Mark 15:35
segments: And hearing, some of those standing by said, Behold, he calls Elijah.

entries.title: Mark 15:36
segments: And one ran and filled a sponge full of vinegar and put [it] on a reed and gave [it] to him to drink. [But they said], Let alone, let us see if Elijah comes to take him down.

entries.title: Mark 15:37
segments: And letting out a loud voice, Jesus expired.

entries.title: Mark 15:38
segments: And the veil of the temple was torn in two from top to bottom.

entries.title: Mark 15:39
segments: And when the centurion, who stood across from him, saw that He cried out so, [and] expired, he said, Truly this man was Son of God.

entries.title: Mark 15:40
segments: And also women were watching from a distance, among whom also was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James the less, and of Joses, and Salome,

entries.title: Mark 15:41
segments: (who also, when He was in Galilee, followed Him and ministered to Him), and many [other] women who came up with Him to Jerusalem.

entries.title: Mark 15:42
segments: And it, becoming evening already, since it was [the] Preparation, that is, [the] day before sabbath,

entries.title: Mark 15:43
segments: Joseph of Arimathea, an honorable counsellor, who also waited for the kingdom of God, came and went in boldly to Pilate and asked for the body of Jesus.

entries.title: Mark 15:44
segments: And Pilate wondered if He were already dead. And calling the centurion, he asked him whether He had died already.

entries.title: Mark 15:45
segments: And when he knew [it] from the centurion, he gave the body to Joseph.

entries.title: Mark 15:46
segments: And he bought a linen cloth, and took Him down, and wrapped [Him] in the linen, and laid Him in a tomb which was cut out of a rock, and rolled a stone to the door of the tomb.

entries.title: Mark 15:47
segments: And Mary Magdalene and Mary [the mother] of Joses saw where He was laid.
